value.approach: Series RISO between the amplifier output and capacitive load; Figure 4-3 takes feedback before RISO.

facts.conditions: Unity-gain buffers are most sensitive; all gains can show reduced phase margin/bandwidth, peaking or ringing. The >100 pF at G=+1 example motivates isolation, not a guaranteed stability cutoff. Figure 4-4 uses VDD=5.0 V and RL=100 kohm. No curve value is adopted; actual gain, load and response checks must determine RISO.
